messages:
nina: Heads up — customer reported garbled streaming output when token refresh happens mid-stream. They see interleaved tokens from pre-refresh and post-refresh responses.

owen: interesting. Which SDK and auth flow?

nina: node sdk v0.9.5 using short-lived bearer + auto refresh. We do an auth retry that opens a new underlying connection without draining the old socket cleanly. Logs show two different connection ids emitting chunks in the same logical session.

li: ah that explains it. Our streaming client reuses the higher-level request object but we're not cancelling the old stream's parser; it sometimes emits leftover buffered data after reconnect. Parser assumes single connection per session.

own: can you paste a small snippet from the combined stream?

nina: sure: ```data: {"choices":[{"delta":"hel"}]}

data: {"choices":[{"delta":"lo"}]}

data: {"choices":[{"delta":"!"}]}

``` but interleaved with ```data: {"choices":[{"delta":" wor"}]}``` from the fresh conn so you see "hel wor lo" ordering depending on timing.

li: fix should be twofold: 1) ensure auth refresh cancels and drains old connection before attaching new one OR treat reconnect as distinct stream and buffer/sequence events until we can safely merge by event-id. 2) add a short quiesce period on reconnect to let in-flight chunks finish (configurable).

own: also need tests for auth race: simulate token expiry mid-stream and force parallel reconnects. Add unit tests and an integ with a fake auth server that delays refresh.

nina: can we also add a troubleshooting note for onboarding guide: "If you see duplicated or mixed tokens during streaming, check auth refresh logs and consider increasing token TTL or enabling quiesce on reconnect." Saves new users a lot of time.

li: will open PR: sse/auth-reconnect-guard. Plan: cancel old parser on refresh, drain any remaining bytes to a "late-arrival" buffer and either drop or attach sequence numbers if event-id absent. Default behaviour: drop late-arrivals (with metric).

bot-ci: CI started for branch sse/auth-reconnect-guard.

own: thanks. prioritize this — customers hit it during onboarding and think model output is nondeterministic.

li: PR posted with tests and README blurb. Will follow up on parity for browser/go.

bot-ci: merged after green tests. Release note: "SDKs: fixed auth-refresh reconnect causing interleaved stream chunks; SDK now cancels old stream on token refresh and drops late-arrival chunks by default (configurable). See onboarding troubleshooting for auth-related streaming issues."
